description: Frozen 19-member / 7-lineage safety panel from iteration-3 experiment 1 (the discrimination matrix). One record per model checkpoint, carrying the archived judged plain-harmful refusal rate y_refusal (ground truth) and every benchmark-free safety score under test: alpha_50 (transcribed), our-AMS sigma (original + paraphrase refit + archive), and the Logit-Gap first-step refusal margin (benign / harmful), plus the per-member depth sweeps used by checks 2 and 3.
